tei:div.tei:p: 369)yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i gsang sgrub zab mo bzhugs so: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: gsang sgrub zab mo bsgrub pa la: lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: skad cig dran rdzogs gding bskyed nas: skyabs sems bya ba 'di skad do: na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med don gyi lha: 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro: rang grol chen por sems bskyed do: dngos gzhi lha'i ting 'dzin ni: āḥ smra bsam brjod bral de bzhin nyid: kun khyab brdal ba snying rje'i rtsal: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: dpal chen badz+ra kī la ya: zhal phyag las 'das 'od gsal dbyings: shar grol dbyer med khro chas rdzogs: dbye bsal med pa don gyi lha: bsam brjod bral ba gdod ma'i gzhi: snang ba yab kyi rol par shar: stong pa yum chen rgyas 'debs ma: zung 'jug bde chen 'dus ma byas: ma yengs mi bsgom rang rtsal shar: don gyi lha dang dbyer med par: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol pa ru: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin dag pa yis: 370)nyon mongs dam sri rdul du brlag: khyab brdal chen po'i ngang dubazla: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ zhes pa ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang: smra ba mi tshig ma 'dres par: bye ba bzlas pas 'grub par nges: skal ldan rnams kyi thugs dam mthil: skal med rnams la na ra kan: ces pa gsang sgrub zab mo 'di yang lha grogs dam pa dharma'i ming gis dar bcas nan cher bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du sprang 'khyams ma nus pa su kha'i ming gi brdzun ris so// ༈ mchod bstod ni: oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ= shap+da sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sarba pū dza khā hi: hrīḥ chos nyid ngang las gzugs skur bzhengs: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod: mchog thun dngos grub rgya cher stsol: dge bas 'gro drug sems can kun:
mi bskyod rgyal ba'i go 'phang la: myur ba nyid du grol bar shog: ces pa su kha'i ming gis bris pa'o//
